entities.name: Keith Mwila
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Keith Mwila was a Zambian boxer, who won the bronze medal in the men's Light flyweight (-48 kg) category at the 1984 Summer Olympics in Los Angeles, United States, becoming the first Olympic medalist from Zambia.
